agents.description: Named subagent presets, layered over the built-in ones (claude, codex, omp, gemini, opencode, droid, copilot, cursor). An entry with a built-in's name overrides it field by field

defaults.agent.description: The preset `start` launches when none is named

defaults.split.description: Split direction when starting next to an explicit anchor pane or tab

defaults.focus.description: Whether starting a subagent takes the user's focus

defaults.bootTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for a started agent to become ready

defaults.replyTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for one reply

defaults.readLines.description: Pane lines read back when collecting a reply

preset.description: One launchable subagent: the argv herdr starts, plus overrides of the launch defaults

command.description: The canonical executable and its arguments, e.g. ["claude", "--permission-mode", "plan"]. Optional only when overriding a built-in preset

kind.description: The managed agent kind; inferred from a canonical command name

cwd.description: Working directory; ~ expands, a relative path resolves from the repo root

session.description: The herdr session to launch in; unset means the caller's own

split.description: Split direction next to an anchor pane

focus.description: Whether starting it takes the user's focus

bootTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the agent to become ready

replyTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for one reply

readLines.description: Pane lines read back for a reply
